markets.question: Will Uzbekistan win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
markets.resolutionSource: Official announcement from FIFA (fifa.com) confirming the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. If FIFA announcement is unavailable, a consensus of major sports news outlets (ESPN, BBC Sport, The Guardian) reporting the same winner is acceptable. YES path: The market resolves YES if Uzbekistan is declared the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup by FIFA official announcement. The resolver verifies this through FIFA's official website, press releases, or credible sports reporting consensus. NO path: The market resolves NO if any other team wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup, or if Uzbekistan is eliminated at any point during qualification or the tournament, or if Uzbekistan fails to qualify for the 2026 World Cup. markets.question: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after the June 2026 meeting?
markets.resolutionSource: The official FOMC statement released following the June 16-17, 2026 Federal Open Market Committee meeting, published on https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm. The target federal funds rate upper bound change is compared to the level established at the prior FOMC meeting. A change of 25 bps (or 12.5 bps rounded up) constitutes a YES. If no statement is released by the end of the next scheduled FOMC meeting, resolve to 'No change'. YES path: Future resolver checks the FOMC statement released after the June 16-17, 2026 meeting. Verifies the upper bound of the target federal funds rate decreased by 25 basis points compared to prior meeting level. Per rounding rules, a 12.5 bps cut also qualifies as YES. NO path: Future resolver checks FOMC statement. If target federal funds rate upper bound remained unchanged, increased, or changed by any amount other than 25 bps (e.g., 50 bps cut or 25 bps increase), resolve NO. Evidence plan: FOMC statement from June 16-17, 2026 meeting (https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm) Target federal funds rate data from https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm Prior FOMC statement/meeting record to establish baseline rate level Download and archive the FOMC statement from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm for June 2026 meeting
